mechanisms.FALSE_ORIGIN_ATTRIBUTION: False attribution of origin or authorship
mechanisms.MISATTRIBUTED_AGGREGATE: Aggregate figure attributed to the wrong universe

sections.trueComponent: What is true in the statement
sections.mechanismHint: Mechanisms describe the distance between the statement and the evidence; they do not assess intent.

DETECTED.title: Statement detected
DETECTED.body: The verification was registered and there is no conclusion yet.

QUEUED.title: Queued
QUEUED.body: Waiting for research capacity to start the verification.

RESEARCHING.title: Searching sources
RESEARCHING.body: The statement is being compared with public documents and data.

EVALUATING.title: Weighing evidence
EVALUATING.body: The evidence found is being compared against the statement.

FAILED.title: Technical failure
FAILED.body: The verification could not be completed because of a technical failure. This does not mean the statement is true or false.

CANCELLED.title: Verification cancelled
CANCELLED.body: The verification was cancelled before completion; there is no conclusion.

DEFERRED.title: Verification deferred
DEFERRED.body: No capacity or quota was available. The verification did not run and there is no conclusion.

BLOCKED.title: Verification blocked
BLOCKED.body: The transcript has uncertain passages that may change the meaning of the statement. Fix or confirm the transcript to resume the verification.

incomplete.title: Incomplete result
incomplete.body: The verification finished without a valid verdict. Nothing is shown as a conclusion.

evidence.title: Documents and evidence
evidence.unverifiedBody: These excerpts were not inspected by the verifier and are not used as proof.
evidence.emptyHint: This verification registered no evidence with an identifiable source.

revision.label: Revision {{revision}}
revision.note: Reviewable result: corrections to the transcript, authorship or evidence can invalidate this conclusion.

controls.pauseDisabled: Capture is not active to pause

setup.title: Listen through the microphone
setup.description: After you click, the browser will ask for microphone access. Veritas listens to the room where the conversation happens.
setup.consentLabel: I confirm the people in the room know the conversation will be recorded by the microphone and sent to Veritas for transcription and fact-checking.
setup.consentRequired: Check the consent box to start
setup.sourceHint: Keep the microphone close to the speakers. If the debate plays on this computer, use the speakers (not headphones).
setup.privacyNote: Only microphone audio is sent, and only while the session is active.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.subtitle: Continuous updates
transcript.speechTimeHint: Speech time in the capture (not processing time)
transcript.gapsNotice: {{count}} audio gap(s) flagged — missing samples are not invented.

workspace.title: Live accompaniment
workspace.intro: Progressive transcript alongside verifications. Audio comes from the microphone; Text mode remains available at entry.

micErrors.UNSUPPORTED: This browser can't access the microphone. Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
micErrors.INSECURE_CONTEXT: The microphone only works on secure pages. Open Veritas on https:// or http://localhost.
micErrors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Microphone access was denied. Allow the microphone in the site permissions (icon next to the address bar) and try again.
micErrors.NO_DEVICE: No microphone found. Connect a microphone and try again.
micErrors.DEVICE_IN_USE: The microphone is in use by another app or blocked by the system. Close the other app and try again.
micErrors.DEVICE_DISCONNECTED: The microphone was disconnected. Listening has ended; reconnect it and start again.
micErrors.NO_AUDIO_TRACK: The microphone sent no audio. Try another microphone.
